_doc: Start of a new game as artisan / blacksmith (GDD 4.16) [balance]. NewGame.from_start reads it. The game starts at `start.phase` of day `start.day` (day 0 = day 1 of spring, year 1). map: data/maps/<map>.json; its "buildings" are placed: the one named in building.site for the protagonist's family, rival.building.site for the rival family, and every one with owner "" as a public building. protagonist: age, title, reputation, the artisan's base stats (GDD 4.2.2) + free_points the player spreads (D5: 5, each stat in [stat_min, stat_max]); carry_weight = 60 kg [balance] (H5: 30 → 60) (the Constitution bonus of 4.2.2 is a proposal), equipment equipped at the start. loan: the amount is data/difficulty.json levels[difficulty].start_debt; due at the end of day start.day + term_days - 1 (term_days 8 = 1 year, 'before the end of day 8'); no interest; if it falls due unpaid: reputation + overdue_reputation and an extension of extension_seasons with surcharge over what is owed; when the extension falls due, seizure (gold, then the forge's goods at market sell price), and if it is not enough, ruin (D18: the game ends). contracts: the scripted ones on the board at the start (pay computed when posted, like any contract). objectives: the chain shown in the HUD, in order (data/objectives/). rival: the AI family of GDD 4.5.5 (its craft and sell threshold come from the difficulty).
_defaults_doc: What the new-game screen proposes (and what from_start uses for a choice left out): protagonist name and gender, family name and colours; H8: the palette tones of hair and skin (indices of data/family.json visual, GDD 4.10.9).
_competitors_doc: H12: the other workshops of the town (GDD 4.5.5 style, no new AI): one AI family with the profile of each, its building on its map site with its stock. Added after the townsfolk and the offices (the ids of before do not move). spouse: they start married (a married head does not court: the town keeps its singles for the rival smith and the player).
